title: Utilizing molecular docking and cell validation to explore the potential mechanisms of lupenone attenuating the inflammatory response via NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Wang, Xiangpei; Liu, Mei; Li, Xiaofen; Zhang, Mei; Xu, Feng; Liu, Hongyun; Wu, Hongmei
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接研究羽扇豆酮与NF-κB通路蛋白结合并做细胞验证，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Diabetic nephropathy (DN), a common microvascular complicating disease of diabetes. Lupenone, a pentacyclic triterpenoid, has anti-inflammatory effects and can prevent type 2 diabetes mellitus and treat renal damage, however, the effects and mechanisms of lupenone in DN remain unclear. Thereby,the MTT method was used to investigate the antiproliferative effect of lupenoneon the cell line rat glomerular mesangial cells (HBZY-1). Molecular docking was used to investigate the combination of lupenone and MCP-1, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, IKKbeta, IkappaBalpha, and NF-kappaB p65 proteins. The expression of mRNA of the pro-inflammatory cytokines (MCP-1, IL-1beta and TNF-alpha) and the NF-kappaB signalling pathway in HBZY-1 cells were assessed by RT-PCR. The protein expressions of pro-inflammatory cytokines and NF-kappaB pathway were got by Western blot. Result showed that lupenone inhibited the proliferative activity of HBZY-1 cells at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Molecular docking results showed that lupenone combined well with the target proteins. Moreover, lupenone could significantly reduced the mRNA and protein expressions for pro-inflammatory cytokines and IKKbeta, p-p65 and p-IkappaBalpha. Lupenone may play an anti-inflammatory role in DN treatment by inhibiting the NF-kappaB signalling pathway. These results provided a new understanding of the pharmacological mechanisms of lupenone in treatment of DN.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（diabetic nephropathy, DN）是糖尿病常见的微血管并发症。羽扇豆酮（lupenone）是一种五环三萜类化合物，具有抗炎作用，并能预防2型糖尿病及治疗肾损伤，然而，羽扇豆酮在DN中的作用及机制尚不清楚。为此，采用MTT法研究羽扇豆酮对大鼠肾小球系膜细胞（HBZY-1）的增殖抑制作用。通过分子对接（molecular docking）研究羽扇豆酮与MCP-1、IL-1β、TNF-α、IKKβ、IκBα及NF-κB p65蛋白的结合情况。利用RT-PCR评估HBZY-1细胞中促炎细胞因子（MCP-1、IL-1β和TNF-α）及NF-κB信号通路mRNA的表达。通过Western blot检测促炎细胞因子及NF-κB通路蛋白的表达。结果表明，羽扇豆酮在非细胞毒性浓度下抑制了HBZY-1细胞的增殖活性。分子对接结果显示，羽扇豆酮与靶蛋白结合良好。此外，羽扇豆酮能显著降低促炎细胞因子及IKKβ、p-p65和p-IκBα的mRNA和蛋白表达。羽扇豆酮可能通过抑制NF-κB信号通路在DN治疗中发挥抗炎作用。这些结果为羽扇豆酮治疗DN的药理机制提供了新的认识。
